notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/42bf1ec93f45b9413db481d625c5278685c5cb26.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello everyone! We continue introducing you to our beautiful girls 😍[/b][/h1]

Today we have Emilia Cullen, a holy sister who runs the Temple of the Goddess of Mercy in the city of Ignacia. She is the spiritual leader of the temple and will help the player level up their character through prayers, rituals, and special blessings ✨

The sister was born in a small village on the outskirts of the kingdom, where her family was known for their devotion to religion. Since childhood, she showed special piety and a desire to serve people. At the age of 16, she decided to become a holy sister and went to the city of Ignacia to continue her studies at the Temple of the Goddess of Mercy. After several years of service in the temple, Emilia became its abbess and began to help heroes and travelers, using her knowledge to level up their abilities and protect them from evil 💒

Emilia has a quiet but determined nature. She is always ready to help those who need support - both spiritual and physical. Her appearance and behavior combine severity and gentleness. Although her appearance may seem modest, she has inner strength and faith that inspire others. Her eyes, one of which is an unusual red color, often cause surprise, but this only adds to her mystery 👀

[h1][b]We suggest taking a look at the parameters of our sister 🥰[/b][/h1]
